title: Payments Account Manager
IDRA Staff Attorney
description:
IDRA is a national nonprofit organization whose mission is to achieve equal educational opportunity through strong public schools that prepare all students to access and succeed in college. Since 1973, IDRA has brought research, policy expertise, community knowledge and legal advocacy together to advance the civil rights of students and families.
IDRA seeks to expand the capacity and impact of its legal team to protect students’ rights amid rapidly changing state and federal education policy. We are looking for a dynamic staff attorney to engage in legal advocacy alongside families, young people, community advocates, attorneys and organizational partners working to advance education justice.
The ideal candidate will have demonstrated experience in movement lawyering, community lawyering or other community-centered approaches to legal advocacy. This may include experience working alongside organizers and directly impacted communities; developing legal strategies responsive to community-defined priorities; supporting campaigns for systemic change; andusing litigation, administrative advocacy and policy work as complementary tools within broader movements for justice.
Potential responsibilities of the staff attorney may include:

• Monitoring high-impact education law developments in state and federal courts and agencies and assessing their implications for students, families, schools and communities

• Supporting and expanding IDRA ’s coalition amicus advocacy, including identifying strategic cases, conducting legal and factual research, drafting briefs, coordinating amici and working with counsel and community partners

• Conducting legal intakes and coordinating referrals involving education-related civil rights issues and identifying patterns that may inform broader legal, policy or community advocacy

• Developing legal strategies in partnership with affected communities, recognizing students and families as experts in the systems and conditions that affect their lives

• Creating and presenting know-your-rights trainings and accessible legal resources for students, families, educators, advocates and community organizations

• Researching and drafting model education policies designed to protect students’ civil rights and promote safe, welcoming and equitable schools

• Training and coordinating volunteer attorneys, law students and community advocates supporting IDRA ’s legal advocacy

• Providing legal counsel to IDRA ’s policy and advocacy teams, including analyses of legislation, regulations, agency actions and emerging legal issues

• Supporting community-centered responses to civil rights violations, including identifying administrative, policy, litigation and other advocacy strategies that may provide relief to individual students while addressing systemic problems

• Representing IDRA in state, regional and national coalitions dedicated to civil rights, education justice and strong public schools
Read more here

Minimum salary is $75,000. Compensation is commensurate with qualifications and experience.
Location
The ideal candidate will be located in or near central Texas. IDRA will consider applicants seeking a virtual or hybrid work environment but will give strong preference to a person located in central Texas (San Antonio or Austin metro areas).
Application Process
To apply, submit the following:

• Completed application form

• Letter of interest

• Curriculum vita or resumé

• Contact information for three professional references
Applications will be accepted until the position is filled.

title: Senior Ads Designer
description:
We're looking for a Senior Ad Designer to own performance creative production end to end for a fast-moving performance marketing agency running 30 active accounts across B2B and B2C. You will take approved copy briefs and turn them into finished, on-brand, production-ready static ad sets across Meta, Google, LinkedIn, and Reddit - without a creative director having to fix details behind you.
This is a performance role, not a brand role. A plain ad with a sharp idea beats a beautiful ad that does not convert, and that is always the call we make. You will be designing for multiple accounts simultaneously, each with its own brand system and hard rules, and you will be expected to catch your own errors before anything goes to review. If you are a senior designer who understands the feed, works cleanly inside someone else's brand system, and produces batches that arrive at review ready to be judged on the idea rather than the execution, this role is a strong fit.
Why You'll Want to Join

• You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)

•
Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy

• Observance of Holidays per company guidelines

•
100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive

• This role requires overlap with US business hours

• Work across a diverse portfolio of B2B and B2C performance marketing accounts with real creative volume

• High-ownership design role where your output directly drives paid media performance across 30 active accounts

What You'll Work On
Static Ad Production

• Take approved copy briefs and design full ad batches in Figma from brief through production-ready delivery

• Design across multiple accounts simultaneously, each with its own brand system, rules, and creative standards

• Resize every batch across all required formats including square, 4:5, 9:16, and 1.91:1 for each channel

• Run the client's QC checklist yourself before anything goes to review - every account has one and you own it

• Flag when a brief is thin or unclear rather than guessing and absorbing the cost quietly

Figma File Management

• Build files other people can actually work in - named layers, real text layers, components where they make sense, exports set up correctly

• Maintain clean, organized Figma files that a creative director or another designer can pick up without confusion

• Work within established component libraries and brand systems without drifting from them

AI-Generated File Handling

• Some briefs will arrive with an AI-generated first pass attached - treat it as a reference, not a draft to polish

• Nothing in an AI-generated file is pre-approved and elements may be off-brand even when they look finished

• If the file is not editable enough to work with, rebuild it and flag it in the ticket - we need to know whether the workflow is saving time

Project Tracking and Communication

• Keep your work current in the project tracker including stage, delivery date, and review owner

• Communicate proactively when timelines are at risk or briefs need clarification

• Participate in two to three review rounds per batch - notes on concept and direction are expected, notes on font sizes and typos are not

What You Bring

• Proven senior-level experience designing static performance ads for paid channels including Meta, Google, LinkedIn, or Reddit

• Strong understanding of what makes an ad stop the scroll and make the offer legible in under two seconds

• Demonstrated ability to work inside multiple brand systems simultaneously without drifting from any of them

• Figma at a real working level - auto layout, components, variants, clean export setup, and files other people can use

• Meticulous attention to detail with the ability to catch your own errors before review

• Comfortable taking direction from a creative director without needing every decision made for you, and able to push back when a brief is wrong

• Comfortable working with AI tools as part of the production workflow

For more information, visit wppmedia.com .

They will be responsible for managing partner relationships with the key digital vendors (Meta, Amazon, Google, etc.) to ensure that our clients gain maximum benefits from trading deals brokered and JBPs. Measurement is a key part of the role, so this role is also responsible for ensuring that digital investment associated with the JBPs is tracked and reported back to the client, to ensure full transparency of pacing versus any investment endeavours in place.

This role reports to the Global Head of Partnerships.

title: Reliability Engineer
description:
Prioritize candidates with medical device or regulated hardware experience, strong background in reliability engineering, HALT/HASS/ALT, and statistical modeling (Weibull, lognormal).
Technical Evaluation - Assess expertise in DFMEA/PFMEA, fault tree analysis, accelerated life testing, DOE, and use of data tools (Minitab/JMP required; Python/Matlab/R preferred).
Regulatory Knowledge - Verify familiarity with ISO 13485, ISO 14971, FDA 21 CFR 820, EU MDR/IVDR, IEC 60601, IEC 62304, IEC 62366‑1, ISO 10993, and ISO 17025.
Responsibilities:
Additional responsibilities for this position are as follows:
Working with R&D, quality assurance and manufacturing teams to develop reliability requirements (including requirements cascade), develop and implement comprehensive reliability test plans for IVD medical devices that align with product development and production processes.
Developing reliability plans and requirements, leading and facilitating Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (DFMEA).
Designing and developing test methods and fixtures to assess the performance and durability of IVD devices.
Writing test protocols, training personnel on test procedure, analyzing data and creating final reports.
Conducting reliability tests and documenting results, including environmental, lifecycle, and accelerated aging tests, to evaluate product performance under different conditions and in compliance with relevant regulatory standards and guidelines.
Analyzing test results and providing detailed reports, identifying areas for improvement and potential risks.
Serving as the subject matter expert and technical representative for the reliability engineering function in project teams.
Recommending design or test methods and statistical process control procedures for achieving required levels of product reliability.
Leading and directing multiple projects in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
Participating in design reviews and working with engineering to drive DFR (Design for Reliability) process and tools and support in defining and executing reliability plans.
Reviewing device failures, performing root cause investigations, and documenting results in a failure reporting, analysis, and corrective action (FRACAS) system.
Compiling and analyzing performance reports and process control statistics; investigating and analyzing relevant variables potentially affecting product and processes.
This position may suit you best if you are familiar with the following:
You have a deep understanding of design for reliability and reliability engineering.
You have a working knowledge of regulations and best practices for medical device development such as ISO 13485 and 21 CFR 820 as well as IEC 61010, IEC 60601, IEC 62506, IEEE 1413 and IEEE 1332.
You can generate data and perform life data analysis.
You have knowledge of building fixtures and performing Life Data Analysis for in-vitro diagnostics medical products.
You can manage multiple projects and prioritize tasks effectively.
You can communicate effectively with other engineers, managers, and stakeholders.
You have a demonstrated ability to lead, motivate, and collaborate with technical teams and drive results. 
You can identify and solve complex problems related to design for reliability.
You can analyze data and identify patterns to develop solutions for potential problems.
You have a strong understanding of engineering principles and are familiar with relevant software and tools.
You can identify and assess risks that can cause delays to project timelines or increase project costs.
You can develop process and methodology to model system and subsystem reliability.
You can work with development teams to drive effective FMEA's and risk reduction.
Required skills to have for the success of this role.
Bachelor’s degree (Advanced degree preferred) in Mechanical /Electrical /Reliability Engineering or related discipline.
10+ years reliability engineering experience in highly regulated industry prefer

title: Associate Director, Payments/Scheme Economics
description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide - including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more - with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

 

ATTRIBUTES WE VALUE

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/us/operating-principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 

WHO YOU ARE

We are looking for an Associate Director, Payments/Scheme Economics to own the integrity, visibility and management of Airwallex’s payment costs, starting with card scheme fees and interchange fees across Visa and Mastercard.

Reporting to the Head of Strategic Finance, you will be the subject matter expert on scheme economics, translating complex and rapidly changing network rules into accurate system configurations, financial outcomes and business decisions. You will ensure we understand what every payment should cost, that those costs are accurately reflected across our systems and financials, and that we systematically identify opportunities to improve payment economics as we scale.

Over time, the remit will expand across other card schemes, local payment methods and the broader payments cost base.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Own scheme economics and rule interpretation: Maintain deep expertise across scheme fees, interchange and network rules. Interpret scheme bulletins, operating regulations and fee schedules, translating changes into clear financial, product and operational requirements.

- Ensure accurate payment cost configuration: Translate complex scheme rules into fee tables, eligibility criteria and transaction-level logic. Partner with Product and Engineering to ensure cost calculation, allocation and customer billing accurately reflect current network rules across markets and payment flows.

- Protect payment cost integrity: Establish robust governance, testing and controls across scheme configurations. Reconcile expected costs against actual network charges, identify anomalies and leakage, and drive root-cause resolution.

- Build granular visibility into payment economics: Develop robust models and analytics across markets, products, payment methods and transaction types, creating a clear view of unit economics, margin drivers and cost movements.

- Drive structural cost and margin optimization: Identify, quantify and execute opportunities to improve economics through transaction qualification, BIN routing, cost configuration, and other levers. Partner with Product, Finance and Commercial teams to prioritize the highest-value opportunities.

- Shape pricing and commercial decisions:

So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Supply Chain to join us in the UK.

POS Hardware and Device Platforms owns the software behind the physical side of Moniepoint 's business: the systems that track, move, maintain and account for millions of POS terminals in the field. That covers inventory and warehouse management, logistics and distribution, repair and maintenance workflows, and the operational tooling the business runs on day to day. It is a backend and distributed systems challenge at real scale - making operational data about millions of physical devices visible, trustworthy and consistent across every market we operate in. It is not a hardware engineering role.
The Head of Engineering, POS Supply Chain, oversees that software estate and is vital as Moniepoint expands internationally and scales device operations globally. The position involves leading the technical strategy for the domain and managing a large engineering organisation in a remote, distributed environment. title: Applied AI Engineer
description:
About BJAK
The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region - this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
The Role
We are looking for applied AI engineers to build AI-native systems for BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This is not a research-only role. We need builders who can use AI to automate real workflows, improve products, reduce manual work and make financial services easier for users and teams.
What You Will Build

• Build AI agents, workflows, tools and automations that solve real customer, product and operations problems.

• Apply LLMs, retrieval, tool calling, evaluations, guardrails and automation to practical financial workflows.

• Create AI-assisted experiences for onboarding, support, KYC, risk review, CRM, operations, document handling and product intelligence.

• Work with product and engineering teams to identify what is worth building, then build it quickly and improve it in production.

• Design around real constraints: accuracy, hallucination risk, latency, cost, security, compliance and user trust.

• Turn manual processes into reliable AI-enabled systems that can scale.

What We Look For

• Hands-on engineering ability, not just AI strategy or management experience.

• Experience building AI agents, LLM apps, RAG systems, automation workflows, copilots or AI-enabled tools.

• Strong coding ability in Python, TypeScript, JavaScript or similar practical stack.

• Good judgement on what should be automated and what should not.

• Able to ship working systems, test quality and improve reliability over time.

• Fintech, banking, support automation, risk, KYC, fraud, CRM or operations automation experience is a strong plus.

This Role Is Not For

• People who only want research projects with no production ownership.

• Candidates who treat AI as demos instead of working systems.

• Engineers who do not care about evaluation, reliability or user impact.

• People who overclaim AI impact without evidence.

• Builders who cannot work with product, ops and business teams.

The Bar
We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.
Location
This role is remote, but candidates must be based in the Philippines . We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in the Philippines .
Language
English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
Interview Process
Our process is designed to move fast:

• Online assessment or practical task

• Technical interview

• CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Account Executive (AE)
description:
About OptimaFI

OptimaFI helps community financial institutions (CFIs) - credit unions and banks profitably grow using a combination of proven data assets, expert consulting, and modern cloud software. We are OptimaFI , striving to create solutions for CFI’s that enable better decision making, transparency, and improved profitability for our clients. Our values are Curiosity, Transparency, Partnership, and Lagniappe - always adding a little extra for clients and colleagues alike. We are an 80-person company growing to 100 in the next 18 months, and we have no intention of ballooning headcount for the sake of it. We move with purpose, invest in what works, and use automation and AI to stay lean and effective.

The Opportunity

OptimaFI already serves a meaningful share of the community financial institution market across software and services. This role is about accelerating software revenue with an experienced seller who can create pipelines, grow existing relationships, and close business across the portfolio. You own the territory and the work required to make it productive.

You will sell to banks and credit unions where reputation matters, and the market is finite. That means relevant outreach, strong discovery, and disciplined follow-through. Find the right institution, understand the need, connect it to the right solution, and keep the deal moving.

Key Responsibilities

•
Create the pipeline. Prospect through account research, direct outreach, relationships, referrals, events, and the existing client base. Be able to show what you personally created.

•
Own the territory. Build software revenue across both net-new institutions and current OptimaFI clients. Know where the best opportunities are and why.

•
Run strong discovery. Understand the institution's stated needs, connect it to the right solution, and know when to bring in a technical specialist.

•
Move the deal. Set clear next steps, maintain momentum, navigate objections and procurement, and carry qualified opportunities through close.

•
Keep the forecast real. Maintain accurate stages, buyer contacts, timing, next steps, and close dates in Salesforce. Requalify or close what is not moving.

•
Open doors for services. Identify qualified service needs and hand them to the right Services seller with the buyer need, context, and next step intact.

•
Help us learn. Record why opportunities advanced, stalled, were won, or were lost. Patterns should improve how we sell, demo, position, and build.

Required Qualifications

•
You've carried a real software sales number. You can walk us through quota, attainment, average deal size, sales cycle, and what you personally sourced .

•
You're a hunter. You have created meaningful pipeline without relying primarily on SDRs, BDRs, or Marketing to hand you opportunities.

•
You've done both. New-logo selling and expansion inside existing accounts. This is not an account-management-only seat.

•
You can own a complex sale. You lead discovery and the buyer relationship, use specialists for depth, and do not disappear when the conversation gets technical.

•
You can learn a portfolio. You are comfortable selling more than one product and translating technical or financial concepts into a clear business conversation.

•
You've sold into a market where trust matters. You understand that disciplined, relevant outreach beats noise.

Preferred Qualifications:

•
Financial institution experience. Community banking, credit unions, fintech, financial software, payments, credit risk, finance, or another regulated B2B environment will help you ramp faster.

•
Experience in change. You have sold in a startup, scale-up, PE-backed, or evolving company where the process and support structure were not fully built for you.

You'll Thrive in This Role If You:

•
Create your own momentum. You do not wait for perfect leads, perfect tools, or perfect timing.

•
Ask good questions before pitching. You care more about relevance than reciting features.

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

Plaid Support ensures our customers' applications can help their consumers live their best financial lives by ensuring our products continue to operate as expected. We investigate the root cause of integration issues, quantify their scope and impact, and when we can’t fix them ourselves, we work with our Growth and Engineering teams to reach a solution.  

 

As we continue to grow, we’re looking for Technical Support Engineers (TSEs) to join the team to help us balance the needs of customers, users and internal stakeholders, while navigating critical technical issues. In this role, you will manage issues from their first symptom to their eventual resolution, communicating with our customers and internal stakeholders throughout the process. People who succeed in this role tend to be empathetic, collaborative, technically minded, and most importantly - customer-centric. They have an interest in learning more about financial services, and are excited to help customers resolve complex issues. TSEs work closely with Plaid’s product and engineering teams, and we have a high technical bar to ensure that we all speak the same language. Our Support team sets aggressive goals to meet the standards our customers expect, and we collaborate cross-functionally with our Engineering, Product, Financial Access, and Go-to-Market teams in order to achieve these goals. This role requires candidates to be based in the Pacific Time Zone (PST/PDT) to align with customer needs and team collaboration

Responsibilities

- Respond to 10-12 customer tickets per day via Zendesk, meeting quality standards

- Troubleshoot customer issues using internal tools and documentation and escalate to Engineering or Partnership teams for resolution

- Work on projects with other TSE’s to improve internal and external processes

- Contribute to brainstorming and project execution (tooling, documentation, process improvements)

- Assist GTM teams with customer escalations

- Collaborate with EPD teams on issue resolution

Qualifications

- 2+ years of experience in a customer-facing role

- 6+ months of experience working with REST APIs, SQL, CSS, HTML and a coding language (Javascript or Python)

- Knowledge of ticketing systems and tools (e.g. Zendesk, Jira), and data visualizations (e.g. Mode) 

- Preferred: 6+ months of experience supporting technical projects and/or process improvement

- Genuine interest and passion for Support 

- Commitment to providing a world-class customer experience

- Strong written and verbal communication  

- Self-starter mentality and ability to work independently

- Effective time management and ability to balance multiple priorities

- Based in the Pacific Time Zone (PST/PDT).

 

Our mission at Plaid is to unlock financial freedom for everyone. To support that mission, we seek to build a diverse team of driven individuals who care deeply about making the financial ecosystem more equitable. We recognize that strong qualifications can come from both prior work experiences and lived experiences. title: Associate Implementation Specialist
description:
About JobGet

As the #1 app focused on everyday workers, JobGet is redefining the future of hiring. Founded in 2019, JobGet began as the only mobile-first hiring platform for everyday workers. Since then, we've grown by joining forces with Snagajob, the largest hourly job board in the U.S., followed by Seasoned, the leading platform for restaurant hiring, and the most recent acquisition of RippleMatch, an early-career recruiting platform serving students and emerging talent across the country. Each acquisition has brought JobGet closer to the frontline, making the platform faster, smarter, and more effective.
While most platforms chase volume, JobGet is laying the foundation for a new kind of hiring infrastructure focused on precision, speed, and real outcomes. Our AI-powered engine learns, adapts, and improves continuously. Employers don't just get candidates, they get hires. Workers don't just search, they get matched. The result is a more efficient hiring process with less friction and better results.
We serve a diverse range of industries, from food service and customer support to healthcare, logistics, and manufacturing. With access to over 200 million job seekers, our platform leverages cutting-edge AI to match qualified, role-ready candidates, automating key parts of the hiring process for faster decisions and better outcomes. By combining scale with precision, we're transforming how businesses hire and how people find meaningful work.
Our mission is simple: to help everyday workers thrive by providing accessible, frictionless hiring solutions that deliver real results. Join us as we continue to build the future of work for the millions of people who power our world every day.
Learn more about our culture here.
Who We Are
We've designed our values to be more than just buzzwords; they're things we can do. We hope that our culture reflects our values by our commitment to living them every day.
Make a difference every day

• Teamwork - We make time to help colleagues across JobGet succeed.

• Excellence - We set ambitious targets, put in extraordinary effort, and persevere until we have accomplished - or exceeded - our goals.

• Innovation - We're a team of creative, outside-the-box thinkers who thrive in a continuously evolving environment. To us, innovation is about questioning the status quo and always striving to do things better.

Have Unwavering grit

• Resilience - By remaining resilient and adaptable, we grow stronger as individuals and as an organization.

• Accountability - We operate with an ownership mentality where everyone feels a sense of responsibility to make us better and always act in the best interest of JobGet .

• Speed - We make decisions fast and execute them even faster. Bias for speed is one of our core strengths and a key advantage over our competitors.

Grow through curiosity & kindness

• Respect - We treat each other with mutual respect, kindness, and celebrate our differences.

• Learning - We ask questions and seek to understand by being genuinely curious & communicative.

• Culture - We believe that each of us is responsible for our culture. It requires self-discipline and the drive to contribute to something greater than ourselves.

What You'll Do
As an Associate Implementation Specialist, you will be the hands-on partner who helps our clients get up and running and see value from day one. This is a role focused on the front line: you'll train and build partnerships with the staff, managers, and end users that work for our clients - making sure they know how to use the platform and get results. You'll call customers daily, run trainings, gather product feedback, and support launches. Because Customer Success is a growing team at JobGet , you'll also help shape the processes and playbooks that let us scale, so an entrepreneurial, self-starter mindset goes a long way.

Veeva is building the industry cloud for Life Sciences through software, data, AI, and Business Consulting working together. Learn more about our products, vision and values, and status as a public benefit corporation on our website.

Consulting is changing, and we’re not like other firms. Veeva Business Consulting was launched in 2019 and has grown quickly and organically to a global organization of over 400 people. Our team is focused on making the life sciences industry more efficient and effective through software, data, and consulting working together.

We expect significant growth in Business Consulting as we look towards 2030, and are looking for great people to make it happen.

As a Consultant in our Global Content Practice , you will help customers bring treatments to patients faster by transforming how they work with Technology, Data, and AI. You will focus on reshaping operating models, driving organizational change, and measuring tangible business value.
You will have the opportunity to shape new ways of working in the end-to-end content operating model - from incorporating AI into a tier-based MLR process, to refining content creation strategy through Claims and Modular Content. Experience: 3+ years in Life Sciences Consulting (Business or Management Consulting preferred)

Perks & Benefits

Compensation: Highly competitive salary and equity in Veeva

•
Growth: Unrivalled career progression in a fast-growing, global team

title: Business Development Manager – Government (Federal, State & Local / SLED)
description:
About Phizenix

Phizenix is a technology solutions company delivering software, consulting, and IT staffing services to clients, including U.S. government prime contractors and public-sector organizations.
Position Summary
Phizenix is seeking an experienced Business Development Manager - Government/SLED/Federal to develop public-sector business, build relationships with prime contractors and government stakeholders, and identify staffing and services opportunities early in the procurement lifecycle.
The role requires working knowledge of how Federal, State, and Local agencies buy - procurement regulations, budget/legislative cycles, contract vehicles, and socio-economic contracting programs - alongside strong core business development and capture skills.
Key Responsibilities
Business Development & Pipeline

• Identify and develop new business across Federal, State, and Local Government (SLED) markets, positioning Phizenix as a qualified staffing/subcontracting partner to primes and agencies.

• Build relationships with prime contractors and conduct customer/partner outreach to uncover staffing and workforce needs.

• Manage opportunities from identification through award, maintaining an accurate pipeline (CRM/GovWin IQ or equivalent) and reporting against pipeline and revenue targets.

Government Policy, Regulatory & Compliance Awareness

• Maintain working knowledge of the FAR/DFARS and relevant state/local procurement codes, and track legislative, budget, and appropriations developments that affect agency spending and procurement timing.

• Monitor agency policy priorities and socio-economic/set-aside programs (8(a), HUBZone, SDVOSB, WOSB/EDWOSB) to inform teaming and set-aside strategy.

Contract Vehicles & Procurement Channels

• Pursue positioning on relevant contract vehicles (GSA MAS, GWACs, IDIQs, BPAs, NASPO ValuePoint) and track solicitations and sources-sought notices via SAM.gov and state SLED portals.
Capture & Proposal Support

• Develop early-stage capture strategies and win themes, navigate RFP/RFI/RFQ processes alongside proposal/capture teams, and collaborate with recruiting/delivery on staffing solutions and pricing.
Relationship & Stakeholder Management

• Build relationships with contracting officers, program managers, and teaming partners; represent Phizenix at industry days and procurement forums; drive new business with a hunter mentality.
Required Qualifications

• 5+ years of Government, Federal, SLED, or Public Sector Business Development/Sales experience with a proven track record of winning contracts.

• Strong understanding of RFP/RFI/RFQ and government procurement processes, including the FAR and relevant state/local procurement regulations.

• Familiarity with SAM.gov, GSA eLibrary/eBuy, GovWin IQ, or equivalent market-intelligence tools.

• Experience building relationships with prime contractors and public-sector stakeholders; experience selling IT Staffing, Professional Services, or Consulting Services preferred.

• Demonstrated ability to identify opportunities before formal solicitation, with strong networking, negotiation, and communication skills.

• Proven hunter mentality and ability to independently build and manage a government business pipeline.

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Public Administration, Political Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Preferred Qualifications

• Existing network of Federal and/or State agency contacts and prime-contractor relationships.

Job Description:

EnvisionWare is hiring a Principal Architect, Systems & AI to serve as the technical truth layer for a company-wide AI-first transformation. Build What Matters at Model N

If you are energized by bringing people together, running events that feel genuine, and helping teams experience our culture firsthand, this could be a great fit.
About the Role
We are looking for an Employee Experience Specialist to join our People team. In this role, you will help execute culture initiatives and programs-leading the charge for our India office while supporting global culture work across the organization. You'll plan and run office events, support our India executive team with town halls, create content, and help employees stay connected to our culture.
This role matters because culture happens in moments-when people gather, when they see recognition, when they hear a clear story about why we exist. We need someone who can coordinate those moments, make sure they happen well, be resourceful and creative, and help people feel connected to what we're building.
Key Responsibilities
Plan and run India office engagement events that bring teams together and reinforce our culture.

Create and edit employee videos (recordings, culture stories, town hall content, etc.) for distribution across channels.
Identify and flag opportunities to improve how we communicate or practice our values.
What Success Looks Like

Build an understanding of Model N’s culture, values and current programs.
Establish strong working relationships with the People team and stakeholders in Hyderabad.
Take the lead on planning and executing at least one India office event or engagement activity.
Learn the tools, processes, and channels we use for communication.
Support the execution of at least one ongoing culture initiative or program.
Over the first 6-12 months, you will:
Successfully plan and run multiple India office events.
Be the go-to person for coordinating culture projects globally and keeping things on track.
Develop strong communication and video creation skills-producing content that sounds like us and looks polished.
Consistently deliver polished, on-brand work with minimal edits.
Demonstrate resourcefulness and creativity-figuring out solutions when the path isn't obvious.

How You Will Grow and Make an Impact

People Leadership: Build positive working relationships across teams. Seek and apply feedback to strengthen your work and collaboration.

title: Electric Propulsion Engineer
description:
COMPANY

NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there.

Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris.

Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators.

ROLE

Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it.

As Electric Propulsion Engineer, you own the design of that thruster: you calculate it, design it, build it, test it in our own vacuum facilities and feed what you learn straight into the next iteration.

You own the testing of your own designs, and your results decide what flies.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Design

- Own the design of our RF gridded ion thruster and its performance calculations, from concept to flight configuration.

- Iterate rapidly to support NEO-1 and our customer thruster deliveries.

- Work with mechanical, electrical and control engineers on each new iteration of the ion propulsion system.

Build and test

- Design and build the test rigs and equipment for propulsion testing.

- Assemble and operate test hardware, electronics and vacuum facilities.

- Run electric propulsion tests on your own designs and analyse the results.

- Plan and run the test campaigns for your own designs.

Verify

- Turn test results into design changes, then re-test.

- Document every test configuration and result so it gives traceable evidence for system verification and qualification.

REQUIREMENTS

Essential

- Strong knowledge of RF gridded ion thrusters, including RF plasma generation, ion optics and neutralisation.

- Hands-on electric propulsion testing, ideally with RF generators, high-voltage power supplies and thrust balances.

- Experience with vacuum systems (pumps, gauges, valves), power supplies, fluid management (high-pressure gas tanks, mass flow controllers) and data acquisition.

- Solid grounding in plasma physics, modelling, diagnostics and ionisation processes.

- Willingness to design, build and test your own hardware, and to work extended hours on-site.

Nice to have

- Experience taking a thruster from design through qualification to flight hardware.

- Scripting for data analysis and test automation (Python or MATLAB).

- Experience running thrusters on more than one propellant, such as xenon, krypton or air.

We are recruiting across propulsion design and test. Apply to whichever role fits you best - strong candidates may be considered for either.

WHY NEWORBIT SPACE?

- Pioneering space technology - Your work on our RF gridded ion thrusters and VLEO satellite platform will redefine satellite operations and challenge traditional LEO.

- Ownership and impact - You'll have a level of ownership that's rare in the space industry, and you'll take part in the full lifecycle of satellite technology.

- Equity and competitive salary - Alongside a competitive salary you receive a company ownership stake, so you share in the technology you help build and in our collective success.

- Comprehensive benefits - Private health insurance with dental and optical cover, and annual health check-ups.

- Hybrid working - One dedicated remote day per week.

- Visa sponsorship and relocation support - We sponsor visas and provide relocation support for candidates moving to join us.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. This role focuses on internal technical enablement, navigating complex customer environments to architect the cleanest possible solutions, partnering closely with Product, and driving best-in-class standards across all of Zip’s integration workflows - with a specific focus on the SAP ecosystem.

description:

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

The role

As a Senior Engineer, you own significant portions of a project and drive them to completion. You take a semi-defined problem, ask the questions that sharpen it, turn it into a plan, and ship it. You're past the stage of needing fully specified tasks handed to you, and you're building the judgment to know which task matters most.

You're comfortable working alongside product managers, engineers, marketing, sales, and finance, and you can explain your work to any of them without retreating into jargon. Most of what we build depends on getting those people to a shared understanding of what's being made and why.

This role is primarily backend focused, occasionally diving into cloud infrastructure. However, you should also be comfortable enough in a modern frontend codebase to apply best practices and create something visually appealing and smooth to use.

• Share what you learn, internally through Slack, brown bags, and DEPT U, and externally through articles or talks as project work allows.

What you bring

• Proven experience building and maintaining production-level backend systems used by real people.

• Strong proficiency in Python .

• Experience with at least one major cloud provider . Google Cloud preferred, AWS or Azure also welcome.

• Daily, real-world use of GenAI productivity tools (Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex) in your development workflow.

• A working understanding of core LLM concepts and where they're a good fit for a problem.

• Fluency with version control (git), Agile processes, and CI/CD tooling.

• The ability to research independently and know when to ask for help, without spinning wheels on already-solved problems

Що варто знати про SKELAR? Це венчур-білдер - іншими словами, компанія, яка будує компанії. З нами фаундери створюють consumer-бізнеси, які стають лідерами на глобальних ринках EdTech, Mental health, Petcare, FashionTech та інших.

ПРО SPIRIO

Ми будуємо Spiritual Growth Platform - цифровізуємо східні практики, щоб людина отримала досвід трансформаційного ретриту будь-де. Наша концепція - «ретрит у кишені». Ми працюємо на глобальному B2C subscription-ринку, де швидкість навчання, якість продукту та ефективність маркетингу визначають темпи зростання.

Що вже за нами:

- 250 000+ підписників, ком'юніті 300 000+ в соціальних мережах

- Апки iOS та Android з рейтингом 4.8 на US, продукт у 8 мовних локалях

- Знайшли юніт-економіку у 2024, кратно зросли у 2025

- Команда 50+ людей з топових tech-компаній, у маркетингу - 25+

Для нас це принципово: ми дуже продуктово орієнтовані, і продукт дійсно дає цінність - люди відчувають реальну трансформацію, повертаються, рекомендують. Це рідкість для маркетингу: тобі не доведеться прикрашати те, чого немає. За твоєю роботою стоїть продукт, яким аудиторія реально користується і в який вірить.

Разом із зростанням продукту ми розширюємо Growth команду і шукаємо Growth Marketing Manager, який/яка допоможе перетворити цю візію на систему, що масштабується.

Місія ролі: Ти відповідатимеш за повний цикл воронки - від першого кліку по рекламі до оплати підписки та апсейлів - з прямим овнершіпом CR і LTV свого напрямку.

Які виклики тебе чекають:

- Драйвити повний цикл воронки end-to-end: quiz → paywall → checkout → upsell - від гіпотези до запуску, тесту й аналізу впливу на бізнес-метрики;

- Аналізувати вплив зміни ціни на CR і LTV по кроках воронки; відрізняти ефект ціни від Meta relearning чи зміни якості трафіку;

- Проводити когортний і retention-аналіз: cancel rate, якість когорт залежно від джерела трафіку чи маркетингового angle;

- Формувати й валідувати нові маркетингові angle - звʼязку крео, контенту квізу та ціннісної пропозиції під конкретний сегмент аудиторії;

- Проводити конкурентний аналіз ніші і шукати нові точки росту;

- Тісно співпрацювати з performance, дизайном, аналітикою й розробкою та аналізувати ключові метрики воронки й монетизації.

Що для нас важливо:

- 2+ роки досвіду в Growth/Performance Marketing у digital-продуктах із subscription-моделлю (D2C, mobile apps або SaaS).

- Практичний досвід проведення A/B та multivariate тестів: самостійне формулювання гіпотез, запуск експериментів, аналіз результатів і розуміння статистичної значущості.

- Сильна експертиза у funnel та monetization-метриках: впевнене розуміння й аналіз CR на всіх етапах воронки, CPA, ROI, LTV, ARPU, payback period, churn та refund rate.

- Досвід роботи з продуктово-аналітичними інструментами (Amplitude, Mixpanel або аналогами): самостійний аналіз воронок, когорт та поведінки користувачів без постійної підтримки аналітика.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, AI Performance
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our ML Optimisation Team (AI Performance)

We're a high-ownership team responsible for delivering production-ready model releases as Wayve's OEM engagements and release cadence accelerate. We're applied and delivery-focused: we take models from "works in training" to "meets product constraints," working closely with downstream inference and performance specialists to get models ready for on-vehicle deployment.

🧠 Your day-to-day

- Owning end-to-end delivery of model releases, from initial requirements through training, evaluation, iteration and deployment readiness

- Training and iterating on PyTorch models with a hypothesis-driven approach, running ablations against clear evaluation criteria

- Debugging model performance: identifying regressions, root-causing issues and proposing fixes

- Collaborating with adjacent ML and performance engineering teams to hand off models, define bottlenecks and align on optimisation priorities

- Communicating with stakeholders on delivery timelines, trade-offs and readiness criteria

🧩 What you'll be working on

- Getting models to meet tight runtime constraints on-vehicle as model capability grows

- Applying practical optimisation techniques such as quantisation, distillation and low-rank methods, where the trade-offs make sense

- Shaping the handoff between training, evaluation and deployment, so models ship quickly and reliably

- Working at multiple levels of abstraction, from high-level model behaviour down to runtime and latency implications

🙌 You should apply if

- You have proven experience improving performance in production systems with tight constraints (latency, memory, bandwidth, power/thermal or cost)

- You have strong hands-on experience training and iterating on deep learning models in PyTorch, beyond high-level tooling

- You're proficient with at least one relevant stack or toolchain (e.g. TensorRT, CUDA, Qualcomm QNN, Triton, OpenCL) and can pick up adjacent frameworks quickly

- You're comfortable moving between high-level model behaviour and low-level kernel/runtime execution

- You're familiar with model optimisation concepts such as quantisation and/or distillation (hands-on is a strong signal, but solid fundamentals are enough)

- You have strong engineering fundamentals and collaboration skills

- Bonus: experience with models under tight latency/efficiency constraints (edge, embedded, real-time), exposure to ML systems from training through to deployment handoff, and embedded/edge deployment including benchmarking on real devices

🌱 Not ticking every box? That's totally okay! If you're passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every requirement.

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve's mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution

title: Senior Account Executive - UHV Payors
description:

Qualifications:

• 4+ years of proven success in outbound sales and high-level account management, specifically closing net-new business.

• Strong experience in a Mid-Market sales motion, demonstrating the ability to navigate longer, more complex deal cycles and break into executive teams (VP to C-Suite).

• Exceptional sales acumen with a deep command of pipeline management. You require minimal hand-holding, ramp up quickly, and know how to independently unblock deals.

• Skilled in selling complex solutions, including SaaS, cash flow tools, or payments products, ideally in a startup or fintech environment. Bonus: A strong understanding of the payments ecosystem and the high-volume credit cards space is highly preferred and will give you a major edge.

• A track record of consistently exceeding targets with clear, quantifiable achievements (e.g., % over quota, revenue booked, average deal size).

• Advanced outbound thinker: You don't just execute cadences; you build highly strategic, multi-threaded outbound campaigns to crack into target accounts.

• A collaborative team player who proactively shares winning tactics and market feedback with peers, Product, Marketing, and Enablement.

• Experience with our target verticals (Wholesalers, Retail, Software, Logistics, and Construction) is a strong plus.

• Power user of sales tools like Salesforce, Outreach, Gong, Apollo, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

A day in the life and how you’ll make an impact:

• Hunt and close complex business: Drive strategic outbound prospecting to identify, engage, and win ultra high-value customers with longer consideration phases.

• Navigate multi-stakeholder deals: Seamlessly manage the full sales cycle, engaging with buying groups at all levels-from operators up to the C-suite.

• Deliver advanced, tailored product demos that connect Melio 's value directly to high-level business metrics like cash flow, operational efficiency, and ROI.

• Manage pipeline with precision: Maintain rigorous Salesforce hygiene and provide accurate forecasting to leadership.

• Host executive Google Meet meetings and occasionally travel for trade shows, conferences, or strategic client visits.

• Consistently exceed monthly and quarterly targets, while acting as a senior voice to help shape the go-to-market playbook as we scale the UHV team.

This is a unique opportunity to make a significant and lasting contribution to the company’s growth and future success.

• 401K matching: Feel the investment of working at a high-growth company.

• Time Off: Time to rest and recharge is a priority for us. We offer competitive vacation time, sick days, holidays, parental leave and wedding days to allow you to take the time you need, when you need it.
